mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may increase serotonergic activity and potentially inhibit fexofenadine metabolism via CYP3A4, while fexofenadine's antihistamine properties combined with MAOI use increases anticholinergic and CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased antihistamine effects (sedation, anticholinergic symptoms) and serotonergic symptoms; use alternative antihistamine or ensure adequate MAOI washout period if switching agents.
